test_array_typing_jaxtyped: test the array_typing.jaxtyped decorator to enforce runtime shape checking on JAX arrays
test_jaxtyped_dataclass: test the array_typing.jaxtyped decorator on a dataclass with jaxtyping annotations
test_invalid_shape_detection: test that array_typing.jaxtyped raises TypeCheckError when array shapes mismatch annotations
test_jaxtyping_env_disabled: test that TORAX_JAXTYPING=false disables runtime type checking in array_typing.jaxtyped
test_jaxtyping_default_disabled: test that array_typing.jaxtyped has type checking disabled by default when env var is unset
